turns.question: By what percentage did our ad spend grow in the week of 14 September 2026 over the week before?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no week-over-week growth metric for ad spend, so I can't give that percentage; ad spend (EUR) was 1,500 EUR for the week of 14 to 20 September 2026 and 1,415 EUR for the week before (7 to 13 September 2026). Late: marketing.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
